layouts.name: Idiada Wet Handling Circuit
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The independently named Wet handling track forms one complete source cycle retaining the northern lobe, westward series of bends and southern return. The operator specifies 1517.5 m for the main circuit, close to the catalogue distance of 1519 m. The mapped OSM trace measures 1562.2 m and has a coarser southern return; the 2020 independent snapshot shows the same main alignment. This is a provisional draft, with the source distance preserved and historical bend detail still requiring review. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1562.2 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
